_about: SYNTHETIC TEST FIXTURE — not a reference list and not for production use. Every name here is invented. Its purpose is to exercise the structural mechanics of confiscation-channel matching (per-limb persecution gating, verification-note surfacing, source rendering) without asserting anything about a real business. Tests that must run against the real bundled list are marked to skip when that list is absent.

documented_basis.summary: Invented basis: entry stands for the case where the documented activity does bear on persecution of a private former owner.

actors.name: Galerie Beispiel
actors.verification_note: Invented weaker-sourcing note: stands for an entry whose second limb rests on a thinner evidentiary base than its first.

documented_basis.summary: Invented basis limb 1: a state-organised disposal of works removed from PUBLIC MUSEUM collections. Well documented, but concerns works taken from institutions rather than from private individuals, so it does not bear on persecution of a private former owner.
Invented basis limb 2: a separately-sourced, weaker claim about broader trading in looted art, which does not on its own establish anything about any specific object's former owner.
